metadata.title: PyGCMS Pipeline: a configurable and candidate-preserving workflow for nominal-mass pyrolysis GC-MS chromatograms
metadata.description: PyGCMS Pipeline v1.3.2 is an archived browser-based workflow for nominal-mass, MS1, full-scan GC-MS and pyrolysis GC-MS chromatograms. It performs configurable chromatographic deconvolution, submits search-eligible reconstructed spectra to a separately licensed local NIST MS Search installation, and preserves the complete returned top-N hit list with original ranks and scores. Version 1.3.2 retains the reviewer-response functionality of v1.3.1 and introduces ClassificationModelVersion 2.1.0 with six operational NOM/diagenetic marker groups (L/P/C/F/S/O). The new S category separately evaluates sulfur-containing / sulfurization-associated products, including thiophenes, benzothiophenes, reduced-sulfur compounds, mixed N/S sulfur compounds, and formula-only S-bearing candidates, rather than merging them into the N-containing/protein/microbial P class. The S class is explicitly documented as a compositional/process-associated annotation, not a stand-alone diagnosis of anoxia, sulfate reduction, or in-situ sulfurization; the known possibility of alkylthiophene formation during pyrolysis in the presence of elemental sulfur is retained as an interpretation warning. Chromatographic deconvolution, raw candidate preservation, exact-toluene handling, and the neutral nine-class structural-product summary are unchanged. The archived v1.3.1 validation and Figure 4 records are retained as historical material; new analyses use ClassificationModelVersion 2.1.0. No vendor-native reader, NIST executable, NIST library, licensed spectrum, licence key, or credential is included. The new version-specific Zenodo DOI should be inserted into the manuscript and CITATION.cff after deposit.
